root_cause: The v0.3 host wrapper assumed that the unprivileged botmarket user could directly traverse/read the GitHub-Control working tree under /var/lib/botmarket-github-control/repo. That assumption is false in the current host permissions model.
architectural_correction: root host wrapper validates exact SHA values in GitHub-Control repo
root host wrapper copies exactly probe + source result + event freeze into a dedicated staging tree
staged directories are root:botmarket and group-readable
staged files are root:botmarket mode 0440 and explicitly verified non-writable by botmarket
selftest and live job execute only staged bytes as botmarket
B15P2_REPO_ROOT points the probe at the exact staged repository root
live job no longer depends on botmarket access to GitHub-Control repo
